blind.description: A freestanding modular wall partition or room divider. The structure consists of a molded beige baseboard with three raised wainscoting panels at the bottom, a mid-section covered in sage-green patterned damask wallpaper with two dark wall-mounted decorative brackets, and a projecting crown cornice along the top. Both the front and back faces have identical trim and wallpaper finishes.
blind.from_above: A simple elongated beige rectangle showing the flat, projecting top trim of the crown molding.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.3 to 1.4 times taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (approximately 7.5 to 8 feet high), and roughly 4 to 4.5 feet wide.
